propositions: Bare substring containment in upstream-URL assertion accepts lookalike hosts like https://pandoc.org.evil.com and https://notpandoc.org, which do not actionably point to upstream
The assertion must be replaced with a scheme+host-anchored regex using negative lookahead boundaries to reject both prefix-style and suffix-style lookalikes while accepting legitimate upstream URLs

The new regex _UPSTREAM_RE must reject https://pandoc.org.evil.com (suffix lookalike) and https://notpandoc.org (prefix lookalike) while accepting https://pandoc.org, https://www.pandoc.org, and https://github.com/jgm/pandoc
CodeQL alert #88 must clear after the fix lands and the default-branch re-analysis runs, confirming the incomplete-url-substring-sanitization finding is resolved
